environment: Node test runner against sdlc-loop.js via the harness loadInternals; python3 branches.py name for comparison; no network

cases.title: branchName inserts a tail with dollar patterns literally
cases.when: branchName is called with the tails $&, $$, $`, $' and $1
cases.then: The result holds the tail text unchanged, as branches.py name does
cases.actual: sdlc/{name} for $&; sdlc/$ for $$; sdlc/sdlc/ for $`; sdlc/ for $'. Only $1 held.
cases.specSource: R-051 acceptance: rt.I.branchName output equals branches.py name for the verify tail

evidence.title: branches.py keeps the tail literal
evidence.inline:
branches.py name --kind verify --id 'S-$&' --round 0 --profile http-api --part 0 --format 'sdlc/{name}'
-> branch: sdlc/S-$&-v0-http-api-0

cases.title: Other hostile tails and odd formats stay literal and do not throw
cases.given: The three formats; a format with no placeholder; a format with both; empty branchFormat
cases.when: branchName gets uppercase, slash, traversal, unicode, bidi, empty, and placeholder-text tails
cases.then: Output equals the literal substitution; lowercase applies only for the lower modifier; empty format falls back to sdlc/{name}

attacks.charter: Explore branchName with String.replace dollar patterns to find a tail that alters the branch name (R-051: equals branches.py)
attacks.observed: pattern expanded: placeholder echoed, prefix or suffix duplicated or dropped

attacks.charter: Explore branchName with the $1 group pattern
attacks.observed: literal (no capture group in a string pattern)

attacks.charter: Explore branchName with traversal, slash, unicode, bidi and empty tails
attacks.observed: literal; branches.py validation is the module's job, not the loop's

attacks.charter: Explore branchName with placeholder text inside the tail and formats with zero or two placeholders

seeds.title: Reachability of dollar tails is low
seeds.detail: The loop builds the tail from the slice id and a fixed profile list, so a dollar pattern needs a hostile slice id. Fix: use a replacer function, for example .replace(token, () => value).
